steps.note: the API built this case's state
Sign in to the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event from the vendor's event list and enter its pricing round.
Enter the decimal price in the vendor bid sheet and submit the quote.
Assert that the vendor portal accepted the bid and shows the round as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page to inspect the recorded bid and calculated totals.
Open the buyer's comparison grid containing the submitted bid.
Assert that the buyer-side rate matches the submitted 100.55 bid held by the event.
Assert that each line amount and the sum total equal the submitted rate multiplied by the requested quantity.
